name: 타락한 오우거
mode: built-in image generation + sprite gutter edit
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production premium dark fantasy painted 2.5D Unity monster atlas. Square 2x2 sprite sheet, EXACTLY FOUR complete independent full-body poses of the SAME monster, each centered in its own quadrant. Real alpha transparency. NO text, labels, dividers, floor, cast shadows or background. Orthographic 3/4 camera slightly overhead, facing screen right, consistent body scale, matching local feet baseline. Top-left idle, top-right anticipation, bottom-left attack strike, bottom-right walk. ALL body, weapons, hair stay central 65% of EACH quadrant with at least 60px transparent gutters around center divisions and outer edges. Highly detailed hand-painted materials, readable silhouette, colored shadows and restrained luminous edge light, no plastic toys, no chibi. Subject: a corrupted ogre siege warrior, towering stocky muscular gray olive skin, asymmetrical broken bronze plate armor, massive but compact stone club held low, one ember orange eye, tusks, leather belts and engraved shoulder plates, teal patina, a torn ochre waistcloth. Strong bulky silhouette, tangible stone, skin and metal detail.
edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production sprite atlas correction. Keep this same exact painted corrupted ogre design and all four poses and details. Make each entire creature including its entire club SMALLER and centered in its OWN quadrant: only 60% of quadrant width AND height. Keep equal body scale and local foot baseline. At least 80px fully transparent margin on every side of every quadrant in this 1280 square canvas. In particular bottom-left club must NOT cross central vertical division. Exactly four, 2x2, true alpha transparency, no labels or extra effects, no cropped limbs. Preserve original art detail. Do not fill the transparent gutter.
